owner_correction_accepted_verbatim: Under the delivery definition we established, this is 1 of 8 delivered, not 2 of 8. Mutation-proven but awaiting independent review is a distinct status.
why_i_got_it_wrong: I counted daily_baselines as delivered because its defect list was closed and its mutation suite was green. That conflates two predicates. DELIVERED means wired and load-bearing. MUTATION-PROVEN means the module's OWN suite kills its OWN mutants — which is precisely the standing lesson 21 says is not enough, and which I had written down myself two hours earlier. This is the fourth instance of the unnamed-predicate family (10/15 vs 11/15 denominators, CAP-slot classes, 'no automation targeting main'), so the fix is the same one: name the predicate on every count.

status_predicates.DELIVERED: wired, load-bearing, and its controls run in healthcheck

status_predicates.RECORD_REJECTED: a preregistration record was drafted AND independently reviewed AND the review returned REJECT/BREAKS. No successor record has been written. This is worse than 'awaiting review' and I previously reported it as the weaker thing.
status_predicates.SATISFIED_BY_PROHIBITION: the item forbids an action; it is met by not having taken it, and the absence is verified rather than asserted
